title: The Old Admiral's Flagship
logline: A dying retired naval captain powers up her decommissioned battleship to make one final journey to her lost squadron's grave across three star systems before repo cutters scuttle the hull.

roles.description: Eighty years old, terminally ill with void-sickness; proud, defiant, refusing to die in a station hospital bed.
Asset recovery factor representing the scrap yard that purchased the battleship's salvage title.
A heavy pursuit frigate armed with tractor clamps and demolition torpedoes.
An informal fraternity of retired crew members who served aboard the battleship during the border wars.
The industrial corporate monopoly holding scrap warrants over decommissioned fleet vessels.
A dead orbital anchorage where decommissioned warships rust under low orbital vacuum.
A distant asteroid field littered with the silent hulks of a forgotten fleet action.
An ancient frontier outpost overlooking the memorial battle site.

public_situation: A decommissioned battleship breaches moorings at {role:mothball_depot} and heads toward the border gate under sublight auxiliary thrusters.
private_truth: {role:aging_captain} slipped aboard her old flagship with a skeleton crew of fellow retirees to fly it to {role:border_cemetery} where her original crew was lost forty years ago.

beats.public_change: Mothball anchorage alarms sound across the system as the antique warship ignites auxiliary fusion boilers.

missions.reason: She needs an outside pilot to deliver high-density thorium ore directly to the battleship's auxiliary reactor before yard security cuts the tether power.
missions.private_fact: She spent her entire naval pension purchasing the fuel chits through black-market exchange contacts.

beats.public_change: {role:salvage_syndicate} files emergency warrants with border gate magistrates, declaring the battleship stolen property.

missions.reason: She asks the pilot to purchase emergency maneuvering thruster coils from the junction exchange and deliver them to her escort flank.
missions.private_fact: Her steering thrusters are misfiring and she is guiding the five-kilometer warship using manual attitude verniers.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to scan the battleship's mooring slip and extract the captain's medical logs to prove she is legally non compos mentis.
missions.private_fact: The syndicate purchased the battleship's salvage title for a fraction of its scrap value through insider bidding.

beats.public_change: {role:salvage_interceptor} intercepts the battleship along the deep-space transit lane, firing electromagnetic harpoons.

missions.reason: She needs the pursuit interceptor disabled before its tractor beams lock her flagship's drive nozzles in the gate transit lane.
missions.private_fact: The interceptor skipper hails offering seventy thousand credits and salvage rights on auxiliary reactors if the pilot disables the flagship.

beats.public_change: The battleship enters the perimeter of {role:border_cemetery}, surrounded by hundreds of shattered warship hulls.

missions.reason: She asks the pilot to carry the flagship's ceremonial battle pennant and final log recorder to the memorial station beacon before her reactor permanently shuts down.
missions.private_fact: She intends to vent her remaining atmosphere and remain in the command chair among the drifting wreckage of her fleet.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot stands at the memorial beacon as the ancient battleship approaches the perimeter of the battlefield graveyard.

options.label: Broadcast the captain's final naval log and let the flagship rest among the graves
Signal municipal tugs to board the flagship and save the surviving crew
Sell the battleship's final resting coordinates to the scrap syndicate

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the interceptor and delivers the captain's pennant.
resolutions.summary: The flagship drifts to rest in {role:border_cemetery}. {role:aging_captain} dies peacefully on her command bridge among her fallen squadron, and {role:naval_veterans} establish an enduring orbital monument.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot defended a dying commander's rogue battleship across three systems so it could take its place in the war cemetery.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot calls municipal tugs to seize the vessel.
resolutions.summary: Tugs board the flagship and remove the elderly crew to station medical bays. The battleship is towed to the scrap yard, and {role:aging_captain} spends her final days under court-mandated custody.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the ship's coordinates to the salvage syndicate.
resolutions.summary: The pilot takes the syndicate bounty. {role:salvage_syndicate} boards the battleship with plasma torches, cutting the warship apart in deep space while {role:naval_veterans} mourn the desecration.

consequences.public_summary: Veterans tell bitter stories of a pilot who pocketed corporate gold to betray an eighty-year-old captain's final voyage.

resolutions.reached_by: Fuel exhaustion strands the warship between jump gates.
resolutions.summary: Fuel exhaustion strands the warship between jump gates. Salvage tugs impound the drifting vessel, arresting the surviving veterans and towing the hull to industrial smelters.

loose_threads.detail: The battleship auxiliary safe contains service badges and personal letters belonging to crew members lost four decades earlier.
A scrap exchange board listed an advance sale of five thousand tons of heavy rolled hull plate before the ship slipped its moorings.
The pursuit interceptor displays an old fleet serial number registered to a naval officer who signed the captain's original dismissal order.

radio_hooks: Perimeter navigation monitoring alerts border traffic to unauthorized battleship engine flares.
Salvage syndicate registers immediate asset repossession claim with inter-system court.
Frontier veterans societies broadcast honorary salutes along historical convoy lanes.

voice_direction.aging_captain: Iron-hard, formal, and halting. Issues navigation commands with precise naval terminology as if addressing a full command bridge.
voice_direction.demolition_bailiff: Tired, legalistic, and exasperated. Speaks of a five-kilometer warship as an oversized scrap liability that needs to be melted down.
